features.name: Development-only Founder Preview for every inspectable app feature
acceptanceCriteria: Expo Go and native development builds expose one catalog containing every canonical Teen and Parent route plus founder tools; web development requires explicit enablement and production always remains disabled.
Point-gated companions open through a display-only preview balance without changing point balances, transactions, Tickets, rewards, or permanent unlocks.
Implemented Crew and Bridge surfaces open in development, with local sample states when real linked-account data is absent, and sample interactions do not write to Supabase.
Age, authentication, consent, accepted relationship, RLS, privacy, moderation, device permission, and server rollout boundaries remain enforced.
OpenAI and Anthropic agents share one provider-aware handoff that distinguishes live features, setup-dependent paths, server rollouts, prototypes, and unbuilt work.

verification.blocker: Exact-head CI plus an Expo Go founder-device walkthrough, confirmation that preview actions do not change real point or reward data, and controlled teen/parent account proof remain before verified status.

features.rollback: Revert the Founder Preview merge. No schema rollback is required because the feature introduces no database migration and writes no preview point, Crew sample, Bridge sample, or Scrapbook prototype data.
